purpose: Make the gaps behind a minimal-pass freeze explicit so they are tracked, not silently locked. Registering UAT debt does NOT lift the freeze.
dtc_review: LITEQDS_FREEZE_VERIFICATION_REPORT-v1.0 debt_register_review — DTC reviewed all 6 items; reclassed F4 items per Finding F4; elevated UAT-DEBT-05 per Finding F3.

debt_items.description: Desktop mobile-viewport tests are skipped in the harness project (12 tests). Mobile viewport governance signal preservation (M-01 through M-04) only executes in the mobile project config, not cross-verified in the desktop project.
debt_items.rationale: Tests pass in the mobile project (confirmed). The skip is a test harness scoping decision, not a functional gap. Cross-project verification would be belt-and-suspenders.
debt_items.dtc_note: Reclassed from critical_bug_fix — this is a coverage gap, not a defect (Finding F4).

debt_items.description: F-WIRE evidence captures are skipped on mobile viewport (6 tests in harness, 6 in XAS). Visual evidence of F-WIRE refusal surfaces exists only for desktop viewport.
debt_items.rationale: F-WIRE functional behavior is tested on mobile (tests pass). Only the screenshot evidence capture is desktop-only. Functional coverage is complete.

debt_items.description: No end-to-end operator cognition UAT with a live human operator has been completed. U1-S1-T1 access evidence confirms surface accessibility but not full operator workflow completion.
debt_items.rationale: The specification accepts MINIMAL_UAT_PASS at freeze time. Full operator UAT is Phase 3 / post-mount scope. The substrate renders correctly per automated verification.
debt_items.dtc_note: Reclassed from critical_bug_fix — a missing test run is not a bug (Finding F4). Phase 3 scope.

debt_items.description: T4, T5, T6 qualification types are defined in the schema (QDS-CORE v0.1.1 section 05) but no fixture data exercises them. Only T1 (learning_path), T2 (monetization_offer), T3 (signal_intelligence) have concrete fixtures.
debt_items.rationale: The generator and validation logic are type-agnostic (driven by fixture input). T4-T6 absence is a coverage gap, not a logic gap. Adding T4-T6 fixtures would be a correctness/coverage addition under the allowed protocol.
debt_items.dtc_note: Reclassed from critical_bug_fix — no bug exists; this is a coverage gap (Finding F4). FP-02 freezes T1-T6 semantics but only T1-T3 have fixtures; T4-T6 are frozen with zero coverage.

Backward integrity confirmed in LITEQDS_FREEZE_EVIDENCE_MANIFEST v1.1 backward_integrity block. No longer registered debt.

debt_items.description: No automated confidence_visible:false enforcement test explicitly asserts that the trust_surface_snapshot.confidence_visible field cannot be set to true. The functional tests verify no numeric confidence renders, but the schema-level constraint is implicit (type system), not an explicit runtime assertion.
debt_items.rationale: TypeScript literal types enforce this at compile time (GovernanceClass = 'lite_experimental', never widens). The functional tests (AS-07, AS-08, FB-02, FB-03) verify no confidence bleeds through. An explicit runtime assertion would be defense-in-depth. R5 confirmed directional-only rendering.
debt_items.dtc_note: Ties to Finding F5 / R5. R5 confirmed; remaining debt is defense-in-depth runtime assertion only.
